items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1960-01-03
items.q: Well, that came in later years after Ragus had died.

ctx.x: Yes, that we know. Now, Nick, let me clarify this. Because remember, you and I are talking as musicians. But the people who are listening to us don't know exactly what we mean. Out of the whole original jazz band that you had in Chicago and later in New York, the only one who could actually read music was the piano player, Russell Robinson.
Well, that came in later years after Ragus had died.
